verdict.rationale: The Intel Core Ultra 7 258V is a laptop processor (hardware). Issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent is a software/service identity capability, so it is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the chip itself ships any API credential or permission-scoping capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
